classification: Level 3 focused CDC correctness/recovery and resource diagnostics; no capacity ranking

input.money: signed 64-bit integer cents; no floating-point money
input.shipping_before_ddl: missing nullable field is projected as zero

consistency.source: InnoDB REPEATABLE-READ transactions, verified from effective server isolation; each mutation includes an atomic operation receipt
consistency.sink: eventually convergent current table at a fenced source/input/output cut
consistency.live_reads: exact historical immutable rows; sampled acknowledged inserts may remain pending during pipeline lag

ordering.key: JSON order_id with Kafka's default keyed partitioner
ordering.target_version: Kafka offset, only while each order remains in one fixed partition
ordering.partition_expansion: not qualified; requires a migration/version design
ordering.updates: Flink emits delete/insert pairs; business revision alone cannot order identical-revision pairs

durability.flink_output: checkpointed Kafka transactions; consumer read-committed behavior is independently probed
durability.checkpoint_storage: owned local shared Docker volume; two retained checkpoints, not an independent backup
durability.witness: external intent/ACK JSONL with fsync, surviving component faults; no physical power-loss claim

retries.business_mutations: none; a commit error remains ambiguous until reconciled
retries.backfill_signal: reuse the same primary-key identity; reject conflicting type/content
retries.target: latest committed keyed changelog offset; retain delete tombstones
retries.airflow: one task retry, same DAG run identity

delete_and_ttl.target: logical absence in the current view; raw CDC and tombstones remain
delete_and_ttl.ttl: not exercised; no claim of physical erasure or bounded whole-history retention

fault_expectations.source_progress_during_hold: at least five additional transaction ACKs
fault_expectations.recent_insert_after_recovery: a newly observed sampled ACK becomes visible within 180 seconds
fault_expectations.final_cut: all eleven output fields and EOF match source SQL on each fixed replica

contract.performance: Level 3 recovery/operation diagnostics; no exhaustive matrix or capacity winner
contract.isolation: local internal Docker network, owned static credentials, no real AWS configuration/resources or hosted exports

resources.scope: Entire observed Make invocation; may include other failed attempts in that invocation. These are not isolated per-case cost comparisons.

environment.cotenancy: Only this margin CDC pipeline; no other heavy lab.

limits: Sample-window deltas exclude startup and exit outside observation. Decreasing counters are treated as restarts and the new counter is accumulated; reset intervals have no CPU utilization estimate.
Short-lived actors may be missed; use native pre-exit cgroup counters as well.
CPU utilization is interval-average percent of one core; short spikes may be missed.
Docker disk bytes are not device I/O latency; absent counters are unavailable, not zero.

measurement_limits: Actors are rate-limited and faults are serial. Operation timings are not saturated backend throughput or a comparison with another pipeline.
Recent-read ages are sampled first-observation upper bounds, not a latency distribution over every write.
Disk phases are allocated-volume snapshots, not continuous transient peaks. Each shared checkpoint/log volume is counted once; all replicas are included.
Container I/O counters do not establish physical device latency, queue depth or physical power-loss durability. Inspect current-incarnation native io.stat and sampled reset-aware deltas separately.
Named-volume disk snapshots exclude image layers, container writable layers, Docker-engine log storage and raw host evidence. They are backend data allocation, not whole-host occupied space.

Resource windows cover the selected test invocations, including their preflight/final verification. They are not a seed-inclusive end-to-end pipeline throughput measurement; startup/seed observations remain separate raw evidence.
All roles share one physical Docker VM. Metadata, source primary, JobManager and checkpoint storage remain explicit single failure points.
